basic_info.description: Welcome to LagunaHayes, a boutique residence perfectly situated at the corner of Laguna and Hayes Streets right in the heart of Hayes Valley, one of San Francisco's most vibrant and sought-after neighborhoods. With ground-floor retail and just steps from local boutiques, cafes, and renowned restaurants, this location offers the ultimate in city living. This spacious 1-bedroom, 1-bathroom home features elegant designer finishes, a chef's kitchen, and a spa-like bathroom, all thoughtfully curated for modern comfort. Expansive windows frame serene neighborhood views, filling the space with natural light and fresh air. Additional highlights include in-unit laundry and a smartly designed floor plan that maximizes both style and functionality. With only 29 homes, LagunaHayes offers an intimate living experience enhanced by exceptional amenities including video concierge/intercom, elevator access to all floors, and a stunning rooftop terrace with panoramic city views, a full outdoor kitchen, and BBQideal for entertaining or relaxing. Don't miss this rare opportunity to own a stylish and sophisticated retreat in one of San Francisco's most walkable and connected communities.
